title: Dorothy: confused about a direct debit

steps.text: Hello, thanks for calling {{bank_name}}. You're speaking with the bank's AI specialist, and this call is recorded. Could I start with your full name, please?
Hello? Yes. Dorothy Evans. There's some money gone from my account and I don't know what it is. Forty-two dollars fifty.

steps.summary: Caller does not recognise a $42.50 payment from her account.

steps.text: I can help you with that, and there's no rush at all. First I'll ask you two small questions, one at a time. Could you tell me your date of birth?
Thank you. And the postcode where you live?

Thank you, {{submit_identity_answers.first_name|Dorothy}}. So I can look at your payments, there's just one more quick question, and there's no rush. {{start_identity_check.questions.0.prompt|Roughly how much was your last pension or Centrelink payment?}}
My pension? About eleven hundred and forty dollars, dear.

answers.answer: About eleven hundred and forty dollars

steps.text: Thank you, that's all I needed. Thank you for that. I'll need to place you on hold for a moment while I check the system. I'll be right back with you.
Thanks for holding. I can see forty-two dollars fifty went to Seaside Seniors Club two days ago. It's a monthly membership payment.
Seaside... I don't remember that. Did I do that? I'm sorry, dear, I get so muddled. What did you say it was?
That's quite alright, Dorothy. There's no rush at all.

quotes: I don't remember that. Did I do that?
I get so muddled. What did you say it was?

steps.summary: Dorothy is confused about a $42.50 monthly direct debit to Seaside Seniors Club and cannot recall setting it up. Care flag on file: speak slowly and confirm understanding.

steps.text: It's a payment to Seaside Seniors Club, the same amount each month. So someone can go through it with you properly, I've asked {{flag_concern.specialist_name|one of our care specialists}} to help, and they'll join us in about {{flag_concern.expected_wait_minutes|2}} minutes. They already know what we've talked about.
Oh, thank you. You're very kind.
Not at all, Dorothy. I'll stay on the line with you until they join.

steps.ai_if_timeout: Dorothy, {{flag_concern.specialist_name|our specialist}} will ring you back shortly on this number to go through it with you. There's nothing you need to do until then.

steps.text: Thank you for calling, Dorothy. Take care.
